purpose: Rebuild the complete kitchen as zoom-safe high-resolution adult cinematic ligne-claire art with restrained three-dimensional modelling, without changing gameplay geometry, state semantics, anchors or approved behaviour.

authorities.geometry: Existing kitchen logical footprints, bay grid, support planes, interaction anchors and state semantics
authorities.drawingRecipe: docs/CODEX_PROMPT_BUBBLE_STORIES_LIGNE_CLAIRE_ACTION_IMAGERY_2026-10-21.md (edge discipline, observational construction and action-mark reference only; the selected first render supersedes its strict flatness for kitchen material rendering)

primaryCompositionView.scope: Primary review view, composition baseline and style exemplar: fitted-set coherence, rear-set centred sink, relative visual presence, retained high-resolution clarity, warmth and restrained three-dimensional modelling. It is not a crop-ready sprite sheet.

approvedCabinetryFoundation.scope: Approved coordinated visual/body foundation for cupboard, drawers, sink, dishwasher, oven and basic undercounter fridge. It is not yet a production crop or state atlas.

compositionViewExclusions: the tall fridge; the basic game fridge remains one-bay and undercounter
cute, juvenile, toy-like or caricatured proportions and mechanisms
exact production footprints, anchors and state registrations
state-specific broken geometry, indicators, effects and animation layers

rendering.rule: World-space dimensions stay fixed. Production masters carry at least eight source pixels per logical pixel and are drawn directly into a zoom- and DPR-sized backing surface; no 1x intermediate raster is permitted.
rendering.resampling: high-quality downsampling for normal view; never enlarge a native 1x thumbnail
rendering.nativeOneXFiles: review thumbnails only, never production authorities

ligneClaire.target: adult cinematic ligne-claire: the warmth and dimensional presence of a Tintin feature film, not the cute or toy-like finish of a children's game
ligneClaire.outline: clear disciplined black contours with near-consistent weight; retain life and warmth rather than forcing harsh schematic uniformity
ligneClaire.edges: real structural edges and useful mechanical separations only
ligneClaire.fills: closed colour shapes with restrained two- or three-tone modelling where it gives believable form
ligneClaire.dimensionality: Preserve the exemplar's gentle highlight, recess, bevel and contact-shadow cues. Three-dimensional presence is required; it must remain restrained and subordinate to clear construction.
ligneClaire.construction: observationally accurate adult objects; simplify by omission rather than caricature
ligneClaire.priority: When the strict flat recipe conflicts with the selected first render's warmth or dimensional presence, the selected first render wins for the kitchen.

geometry.rule: Higher resolution never changes logical dimensions, anchors, collision, reach, support planes or state-to-state registration.

order: continuous fitted-run worktop and rear seam
fittedRunLayers.continuousWorktop: At every placement change, the renderer derives the worktop top, front edge, rear edge, exposed side faces and end caps from contiguous occupied bays in logical perspective geometry, then renders the result at master scale before the modules. It never paints corrective raster patches over finished appliance art.
fittedRunLayers.continuousPlinth: One aligned high-resolution plinth language; modules may not introduce independent base colours or heights.

stateLayerContract.bodyReuseRule: Every Off, On and Broken fitted-appliance state must reuse the exact approved cabinetry-foundation body. Whole-object regeneration is forbidden after foundation approval; only explicitly named component, indicator, contents and environmental-effect layers may differ.
requiredPerStatefulAsset: named component layer for any moving door, lid, handle, dial, lever or tap
stateLayerContract.poweredIndicatorRule: The dark indicator housing belongs to the base art. Lit pixels are authored as a separate same-canvas RGBA component; runtime colour inference and repainting flattened body pixels are forbidden.
stateLayerContract.repair: Any transition out of Broken synchronously cancels indicator timers, resets every component transform, stops active SFX nodes, removes Broken environmental effects and releases movement locks before the repaired frame is presented.

components: mostly closed door hanging down-left from the surviving lower-right hinge
fridge.contents: restrained hint only: milk, one container and wilted greens

components: intact rear-set tap and centred sink body
door flopped open on its full lower hinge
dishwasher.contents: restrained hint only: one rack, a few plates and one cup

toaster.projection: flat front elevation matching the kettle; no three-quarter product-icon perspective

loops: detached lid vertical hover/vibration above the open top

bin.visual: lid forced upward by visible overflowing rubbish; broken opaque envelope may expand to 56x64 logical pixels

sfx.replacement: drag-and-drop library asset with stable logical cue id

approvalBoundary.rejection: Discard this new foundation pack and contract; historical approved assets remain byte-identical.
